title: Erlang Loss Model with Energy Constrained Servers
summary: In this paper, we study an Erlang-type loss system with energy-constrained servers. Each server is equipped with a finite battery and becomes temporarily unavailable for service when its energy is depleted, entering a charging phase before returning to operation upon full recharge. Customers who arrive to find all servers unavailable are blocked and lost immediately. We characterize the steady-state behavior of this two-dimensional Markov process by extending classical truncation results for Jackson networks to incorporate energy dynamics.
